capabilities.title: Precision Corrugated Manufacturing Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: From custom board chemistry to rapid automated cutting, explore how our technical setup delivers unmatched protection.

capabilities.title: 100% Bespoke Dimensions
capabilities.description: No standard mould restrictions. Specify your Length, Width, and Depth in millimeters, inches, or centimeters for tight-fit protection.

capabilities.title: Flute & Ply Customization
capabilities.description: Choose from 3-Ply, 5-Ply, or 7-Ply board architectures with B-Flute, C-Flute, E-Flute, or hybrid BC & AAC combinations for heavy export stacking.

capabilities.title: Flexographic & Screen Printing
capabilities.description: High-speed 1 to 4 colour branded flexo printing, water-based eco-friendly inks, QR code serialization, and barcode compliance for Amazon/Flipkart.

capabilities.title: Barrier & Water-Resistant Coatings
capabilities.description: Functional anti-humidity coatings, oil/grease barrier liners for perishable foods, and anti-static ESD coatings for sensitive electronic PCBs.

capabilities.title: 24-Hour Digital Prototype
capabilities.description: Receive automated CAD 3D layout proofs and flat dieline templates within 24 hours of submitting your outer dimensions and weight load.

capabilities.title: Scalable Production Runs
capabilities.description: Whether you need pilot test batches of 500 units or commercial monthly contracts exceeding 500,000 corrugated cartons, our plant scales seamlessly.

process.title: Four Steps to Your Custom Packaging
process.subtitle: A streamlined, transparent workflow engineered to take your product from raw dimensions to dock delivery in days.

steps.title: Requirement & Spec Submission
steps.desc: Share your internal product dimensions, weight, stacking height, and any branding artwork or dieline preferences.

steps.title: CAD Engineering & 3D Proof
steps.desc: Our packaging designers compute flute thickness, bursting pressure (B.F.), and generate an accurate 3D preview within 24 hours.

steps.title: Physical Prototype Approval
steps.desc: For custom die-cuts and bulk production runs, we produce a physical sample box for hands-on drop-test and fitment confirmation.

steps.title: Automated Production & Dispatch
steps.desc: Upon final approval, your custom batch enters automated corrugation, rotary die-cutting, flexo printing, and bundled delivery.

configurator.title: Configure Your Custom Box Specifications
configurator.subtitle: Input your box size, preferred wall ply, and printing requirements to generate an instant engineering summary and request an expedited quotation.
configurator.successMessage: Configuration saved! Our engineering team will reach out with the dieline drawing.
configurator.guaranteeNote: We provide custom die-lines and sample boxes prior to commercial production runs to ensure 100% fit accuracy.
